locator.original_text: A student of Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (Buet) was killed and two others were injured as a car hit their motorcycle in Purbachal’s 300 Feet area in Rupganj, Narayanganj early on Friday.

text: A student of Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (Buet) was killed and two others were injured as a car hit their motorcycle in Purbachal’s 300 Feet area in Rupganj, Narayanganj early on Friday.

locator.original_text: The deceased was Motasim Masud, 22, a second-year computer science and engineering student.

text: The deceased was Motasim Masud, 22, a second-year computer science and engineering student.

locator.original_text: Injured Amit Saha, 22, and Mehedi Hasan, 21, are from the same department.

text: Injured Amit Saha, 22, and Mehedi Hasan, 21, are from the same department.

locator.original_text: Police later detained the car’s driver in connection with the fatal crash.

text: Police later detained the car’s driver in connection with the fatal crash.

locator.original_text: According to their classmate Faiyaz, Motasim lived in Kalabagan, while Amit and Mehedi are residents of Buet’s Ahsanullah Hall.

text: According to their classmate Faiyaz, Motasim lived in Kalabagan, while Amit and Mehedi are residents of Buet’s Ahsanullah Hall.

locator.original_text: Rupganj police station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Liakat Ali said Motasim had died on the spot, adding that Amit and Mehedi had been admitted to Kurmitola General Hospital.

locator.original_text: The car’s driver, Sadman, had been detained, the OC said, mentioning that two others who had also been in the vehicle had been taken to the police station for questioning.
